Chapter 152 and his/her regular salary without such absence being charged against available sick leave credits, even if such absence may be for less than six calendar days' duration.

### Section 8.2 Paid Personal Leave

On each January 1, full-time employees on the payroll as of that date will be credited annually with paid personal leave credits at the following rate:


<table border=1 style='margin: auto; word-wrap: break-word;'><tr><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>Scheduled Hours per Week</td><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>Personal Leave Credits</td></tr><tr><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>37.5 hours per week</td><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>22,500 hours</td></tr><tr><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>40.0 hours per week</td><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>24,000 hours</td></tr></table>

Such personal leave may be taken during the following twelve (12) months at a time or times requested by the employee and approved by his/her Appointing Authority. Full-time employees hired or promoted into the bargaining unit after January 1 of each year who have not been credited with personal leave during said year will be credited with personal leave days in accordance with the following schedule:


<table border=1 style='margin: auto; word-wrap: break-word;'><tr><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>Date of Hire or Promotion into Unit</td><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>Scheduled Hours per Week</td><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>Personal Leave Hours Credited</td></tr><tr><td rowspan="2">January 1 - March 31</td><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>37.5</td><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>22.500 Hours</td></tr><tr><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>40.0</td><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>24.000 Hours</td></tr><tr><td rowspan="2">April 1 - June 30</td><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>37.5</td><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>15.000 Hours</td></tr><tr><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>40.0</td><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>16.000 Hours</td></tr><tr><td rowspan="2">July 1 - September 30</td><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>37.5</td><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>7.5000 Hours</td></tr><tr><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>40.0</td><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>8.000 Hours</td></tr><tr><td rowspan="2">October 1 - December 31</td><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>37.5</td><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>0.000 Hours</td></tr><tr><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>40.0</td><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>0.000 Hours</td></tr></table>

Any paid personal leave not taken by December 31 $ ^{st} $ will be forfeited by the employee to the Employee Illness Leave Bank (E.I.L.B). Personal leave days for regular part-time employees will be granted on a pro-rata basis. Personal leave may be available in units of one-half hour and may be used in conjunction with vacation leave.

Nothing in this Section shall be construed as giving more than three (3) days personal leave in a given calendar year.
